freeCheck.title: Try a free check first
freeCheck.what: Runs your own agent on one task of {{suite}} with a practice model instead of a real one: it costs $0 and shows the agent starts and finishes. It needs a worker online and gives no score; a full evaluation calls real models and costs money.
freeCheck.builtin: The free check is for your own agents: {{agent}} is built in and already checked.
freeCheck.ownsModel: The free check cannot run on {{agent}}: it calls its own model, so the practice model cannot stand in for it.
freeCheck.noAgent: Pick one of your own agents in step 1 to try the free check.
freeCheck.noBenchmark: Pick a benchmark in step 3 to try the free check: it uses that benchmark's first task.

suitesCli.intro: On your own machine, this fetches the source and adds it as a benchmark of your organization.
